dct_description_sm:
Ontarians may need to determine their regional Conservation Authority when attempting to acquire a building permit, access regional natural area or inquire about Conservation Authority events, practices and resources. Conservation Ontario has developed this layer to enable members of the public to easily determine their regional Conservation Authority and to visualize all 36 Conservation Authorities within one layer.

Note:

This layer was updated in December 2023
dct_rights_sm: The results of this layer may not be perfectly accurate, and should be only used to estimate a properties regional Conservation Authority. This layer is not be used in analysis and should be used for visual representation only. Please refer to the individual Conservation Authority boundary for the most accurate layer.
